title: TIEM: Temporal Integration of Hypergraph Evidence and Skill Memory for Event-Driven Financial Forecasting

claim.summary: TIEM combines timestamp-filtered event hypergraphs with outcome-derived skill memory to predict catalyst-linked financial directions.

modules.name: Evidence and skill ancestry time gates
modules.scope_reason: Availability is determined by event timestamps and every skill ancestor resolution time; the gate encodes temporal admissibility rather than a financial output rule.

modules.name: Outcome-informed catalyst skill retrieval
modules.scope_reason: Memory rules, advantage and reasoning paths predict catalyst-linked positive/negative financial returns.
